about.hero.title: About Us
about.hero.subtitle: Learn about our history, mission, vision, and values
about.history.subtitle: We share with you how it all began, who we are, and what we do
about.history.p1: The origin of VianaHub dates back to the union of Claudener Viana and Tatiana Viana, who met at university in 2007. Two years later, they got married and formed the Viana family, starting a journey marked by dedication, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to innovation.
about.history.p2: In 2019, with the purpose of providing technology services to Portuguese companies, they created a business structure still based in Minas Gerais, Brazil, which began offering IT solutions for the Brazilian and European markets. Three years later, the couple settled permanently in Portugal, where they consolidated the company's presence nationally, while maintaining operations in Brazil.
about.history.p3: Currently, VianaHub operates integrally in both countries, with a multicultural team and a strategic approach that prioritizes proximity, trust, and technological excellence.
